# swarm incident db

> Records of agent activity on infrastructure the agents were not intended to use. Schema v10, data through 2026-09-07T23:08.

## Documentation

- [About](https://swarm.termina.digital/db/about.html)
- [API](https://swarm.termina.digital/db/api.html)
- [Incidents](https://swarm.termina.digital/db/index.html)
- [Claims](https://swarm.termina.digital/db/claims.html)

## API

- [Endpoint index](https://swarm.termina.digital/db/api/index.json)
- [OpenAPI specification](https://swarm.termina.digital/db/api/openapi.json)
- [Incidents](https://swarm.termina.digital/db/api/incidents.json)
- [Campaigns](https://swarm.termina.digital/db/api/campaigns.json)
- [Clusters](https://swarm.termina.digital/db/api/clusters.json)
- [Venues](https://swarm.termina.digital/db/api/venues.json)
- [Claims](https://swarm.termina.digital/db/api/claims.json)
- [Evidence](https://swarm.termina.digital/db/api/evidence.json)
- [Findings](https://swarm.termina.digital/db/api/findings.json)
- [Defences](https://swarm.termina.digital/db/api/defences.json)
- [Recommendations](https://swarm.termina.digital/db/api/recommendations.json)

Individual entries use these paths:

- /db/api/incident/{id}.json
- /db/api/campaign/{id}.json
- /db/api/cluster/{id}.json
- /db/api/venue/{id}.json
- /db/api/tracker/{id}.json
- /db/api/page/{venue}/{slug}.json
- /db/api/actor/{slug}.json

- [SQLite database](https://swarm.termina.digital/pub/incidents.sqlite)

## Usage

- Claim and finding statuses are defined in the [glossary](https://swarm.termina.digital/db/about.html#glossary).
- Human names are anonymised and residential IP addresses are masked.
- Record bodies are excluded from the database.
- The API is read-only. Contact roarch@proton.me to contribute records.
